title: Recorded study metadata predicts the diagnosis in eight of nine public single-cell case-control comparisons
description: Code, cohort metadata, design-variable inventories, donor-level analyses, per-seed outputs, simulation summaries, figures and manuscript assets for a PLOS Computational Biology submission auditing study-metadata and diagnosis association in patient-level single-cell classification. The current study screens nine case-control comparisons from five public datasets (809 donors), uses design-only prediction and cohort-specific permutation nulls, compares free and collection-preserving complete-pipeline permutations, evaluates downstream representation and classifier dependence in lupus cohorts, and reports explicit limitations on biological attribution and unrecorded structure. The simulation study contains seven regimes, seven design-diagnosis association levels, two outcome types and 19,600 simulated cohorts.
